text: Adjacent strings shall not concatenate. Raw/triple-quoted strings, character literals, `\\xNN`, brace Unicode escapes, string splicing, and string-valued computation operands shall be rejected. Strings shall not allocate storage.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
